Your score weights

Fitted presets use the 10 raw-stat metrics and are scored out-of-sample (training matches excluded). Heads-up: giving weight to the four share metrics lets a score reconstruct team totals (e.g. gold ≈ share × team gold), which inflates AUC — that reads team dominance, not individual impact.
